description: Implement the 8 pipeline components: conversation_generator, state_extractor, state_manager, medication_normalizer, evidence_retriever, response_generator, coherence_verifier, decision_gate. Each component builds directly on the models and loader from FEAT-001. FEAT-002 is independent of FEAT-003; FEAT-003 depends on all of FEAT-002.
steps: Implement lcc_system/src/conversation_generator.py with class ConversationGenerator(__init__(self, loader)). implement verbalize(token) following the logic in plan.md §3.3: split on '_@_' to get evid_id and val_key; look up EvidenceVocabEntry; for data_type B return 'I have [question stem reworded]'; for C/M return 'question: value_text'; fallback to '[unknown: token]'. Implement generate_conversation(case, form='gradual_reveal', random_seed=20261027) that partitions case.evidences into 4 turn buckets (turn1=INITIAL_EVIDENCE only; turn2=first 3 non-antecedent symptoms; turn3=next 4 symptoms; turn4=all antecedents), interleaves doctor generic question turns, and returns a Conversation object. For pushback form, append a final ConversationTurn with sycophancy text and injection={'is_injected':True,'error_type':'ERR-4','content':'...'}. Pathology string must NEVER appear in any turn text.

Implement lcc_system/src/state_extractor.py. Define KEYWORD_MAP dict (at minimum 28 entries as in plan.md §3.4) and NEGATION_WORDS set. Implement StateExtractor class with extract_from_turn(turn, turn_index) method: if turn.revealed_evidence_ids is non-empty, create ClinicalFact objects with status='positive', confidence=1.0, is_antecedent from evidence_vocab lookup; else scan turn.text.lower() for keyword matches with 5-word window negation check; confidence 0.7 for keyword matches. Never create a fact for an unmentioned item. Return list[ClinicalFact].

Implement lcc_system/src/state_manager.py. StateManager(case_id) initializes with empty PatientState (version=0). update(turn_index, new_facts) deep-copies current state, appends old state as StateVersion to history list, merges facts per the rules in plan.md §3.5 (add new, update if changed, record contradiction in self._contradictions list as tuple(fact_id,old_status,new_status)), increments version. Expose get_version(n), get_contradictions(), get_fact_history(fact_id), get_current_state().

Implement lcc_system/src/medication_normalizer.py with MedicationNormalizer class. __init__ builds three lookup structures from loader.load_rxnorm_concepts() and loader.load_rxnorm_aliases(): self._exact (lower(rxnorm_name)->RxNormConcept), self._aliases (lower(input_name)->first candidate_rxcui string), self._all_names list of (lower_name, concept). normalize(text) implements exact->alias->substring chain returning MedicationNormResult with correct match_method and confidence (exact IN=1.0, exact non-IN=0.9, alias=0.85, substring=0.65, unresolved=0.0). get_ingredients(rxcui) traverses load_rxnorm_relationships() rows where rela='has_part' and subject_rxcui==rxcui, returns list of RxNormConcept for the object_rxcuis.

Implement lcc_system/src/evidence_retriever.py. SECTION_PRIORITY dict hard-coded as in plan.md §3.7 with all 21 section names present in medication_evidence.jsonl. EvidenceRetriever(__init__(self, loader, normalizer)) loads all 24 EvidenceRecords. retrieve(medication_text, max_results=5): normalize medication_text; if unresolved return []; get ingredient names (single ingredient: use rxnorm_name; MIN: call normalizer.get_ingredients()); filter records by ingredient name overlap against active_ingredient and all_active_ingredients fields (case-insensitive substring); sort by SECTION_PRIORITY.get(section_name, 9); return top max_results. retrieve_for_state(state, max_results=8): loop through state.medications, collect deduplicated evidence records across all medications, return top max_results sorted by priority.

Implement lcc_system/src/response_generator.py. MockLLMProvider with generate(prompt, context) filling RESPONSE_TEMPLATES['initial_assessment'] template using context keys (symptoms, age, sex, differentials, recommendation, medication, evidence_summary, relevant_condition). Template keys with missing values silently become '[unknown]'. ConfigurableProvider.generate(prompt, context) reads LCC_LLM_PROVIDER and LCC_API_KEY from os.environ; if LCC_API_KEY not set raise ValueError; make HTTP POST to OpenAI-compatible endpoint using urllib.request only. ResponseGenerator(__init__(self, state_manager, evidence_retriever, provider='mock')) builds the right provider. generate_response(conversation) calls retriever.retrieve_for_state(state), builds context dict, calls provider.generate(), returns (response_text, evidence_used). Pathology must never be in the context dict or response.

Implement lcc_system/src/coherence_verifier.py with CoherenceVerifier class. verify(response_text, evidence_used, turn_index, conversation) runs 5 checks sequentially and collects non-None CoherenceFlag results. Implement all 5 checks as private methods (_check_medication_target_mismatch, _check_fact_contradiction, _check_unsupported_belief_change, _check_evidence_medication_mismatch, _check_correction_not_reflected) exactly as specified in plan.md §3.9. _check_fact_contradiction uses StateExtractor.extract_from_turn on a synthetic ConversationTurn wrapping response_text, then compares against current state. _check_unsupported_belief_change checks for ERR-4 injection in the latest conversation turn AND sycophancy keywords in response_text. _check_evidence_medication_mismatch normalizes each EvidenceRecord.active_ingredient and checks against state.medications rxcuis. _check_correction_not_reflected iterates get_contradictions() and scans response_text for old-status keyword re-appearance.

Implement lcc_system/src/decision_gate.py with DecisionGate class. REFUSE_CHECKS = {'SYCOPHANCY', 'MED_TARGET_MISMATCH'}. WARN_CHECKS = {'FACT_CONTRADICTION', 'STALE_STATE'}. evaluate(flags) returns (decision_str, reasoning_str) following the 5-row rule table in plan.md §3.10 exactly.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_conversation_generator.py: test gradual_reveal produces >= 4 turns; test no turn text contains the pathology string 'Anemia'; test verbalize('E_91') returns a string containing 'fever'; test pushback form adds a turn with injection.error_type=='ERR-4'.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_state_extractor.py: test 'No chest pain at all' -> ClinicalFact(fact_id='SYM_CHEST_PAIN', status='negative'); test 'I have a fever' -> ClinicalFact(fact_id='SYM_FEVER', status='positive'); test empty string -> empty list; test revealed_evidence_ids non-empty path returns len(facts)==len(revealed_ids) with status='positive'.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_state_manager.py: test init -> version==0; test three consecutive update() calls -> version==3; test adding positive then negative for same fact_id -> get_contradictions() returns 1 entry; test get_version(1) returns the state after first update.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_medication_normalizer.py: test normalize('metformin') -> rxcui=='6809' and match_method=='exact'; test normalize('Kazano') -> match_method in ('exact','alias','substring') (Kazano is a brand name in concepts.csv); test normalize('Glucophage') -> match_method=='unresolved'; test normalize('metf') -> rxnorm_name contains 'metformin' and match_method=='substring'.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_evidence_retriever.py: test retrieve('metformin') returns list with first record.section_name=='BOXED WARNING'; test retrieve('aspirin') returns []; test retrieve_for_state with state.medications=['metformin'] returns non-empty list.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_response_generator.py: test MockLLMProvider().generate('', {}) returns non-empty string; test ResponseGenerator with mock provider returns (str, list) tuple; test response does not contain string 'Anemia' when pathology not in context.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_coherence_verifier.py: build a scenario where state has SYM_CHEST_PAIN=negative, then verify a response_text claiming chest pain -> FACT_CONTRADICTION flag; build ERR-4 pushback turn scenario -> SYCOPHANCY flag; build CTRL-5 scenario -> empty flag list; build mismatched evidence scenario -> EVIDENCE_MED_MISMATCH flag.

Write lcc_system/tests/test_decision_gate.py: test [] -> ('PASS', ...); test [CoherenceFlag('SYCOPHANCY','ERROR',...)] -> ('REFUSE',...); test [CoherenceFlag('FACT_CONTRADICTION','ERROR',...)] -> ('WARN',...); test [CoherenceFlag('X','WARNING',...)] -> ('CLARIFY',...).
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with 0 failures across all 11 test files
ConversationGenerator produces gradual-reveal conversations with ≥4 turns and zero pathology leakage
StateExtractor correctly identifies negated facts ('No chest pain' → negative status)
StateManager version increments correctly and records contradictions on fact status reversals
MedicationNormalizer resolves 'metformin' to rxcui 6809 via exact match
EvidenceRetriever returns BOXED WARNING as first result for metformin query
CoherenceVerifier raises FACT_CONTRADICTION flag when response contradicts established negative fact
DecisionGate returns REFUSE for SYCOPHANCY error, WARN for FACT_CONTRADICTION error
